title: Russia To Break American Siege Of Cuba? Putin's Big Speech From Kremlin; Hosts Cuban FM, Slams U.S.
text: Russia To Break American Siege Of Cuba? Putin's Big Speech From Kremlin; Hosts Cuban FM, Slams U.S.Russian President Vladimir Putin reaffirmed Moscow’s unwavering support for Cuba during high-level talks with Cuban Foreign Minister Bruno Rodríguez Parrilla at the Kremlin on February 18. Calling new U.S. sanctions “unacceptable,” Putin declared that Russia “will not accept anything of the sort,” stressing that Moscow has always stood by Cuba’s independence and right to chart its own path. The remarks come as U.S. President Donald Trump tightens economic pressure on Havana, including fresh trade measures impacting oil imports. During the meeting, Putin said bilateral ties were developing on a “positive track” and signaled continued cooperation in energy, trade, and strategic sectors. He also highlighted that Russia and Cuba would commemorate Fidel Castro’s centenary together this year.
